# 8 teams in 2 groups (snake: A = 1 4 5 8, B = 2 3 6 7), the top 2 cross into the knockout.
teams 8
stage groups groups=2 advance=2
stage knockout
# Group A: 5 surprises and wins it, 1 second.
play 1-4 1
play 1-5 5
play 1-8 1
play 4-5 5
play 4-8 4
play 5-8 5
# Group B: by seed.
play 2-3 2

play 2-7 2
play 3-6 3
play 3-7 3
play 6-7 6
expect standings 1 A 5 1 4 8
expect standings 1 B 2 3 6 7
expect ready 3-5 1-2               # A1 vs B2, B1 vs A2
